name: @adamziel/web-polyfills
description: Monorepo for browser-based kernel and VS Code web extension

scripts.dev: concurrently -n extension,vscode,proxy,browser "nx run kernel-vscode-extension:watch" "npm run build; npx @vscode/test-web --browserType none --extensionDevelopmentPath=./packages/web-extensions/ --host=127.0.0.1 --port=3958" "nx run vscode-web:proxy" "node scripts/open-vscode.js"
scripts.dev2: concurrently -n extension,vscode,proxy,browser "nx run kernel-vscode-extension:watch" "nx run vscode-web:dev" "nx run vscode-web:proxy" "node scripts/open-vscode.js"
scripts.clean: nx reset && rm -rf dist packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules node_modules

author: Automattic
